name: Project {OS}
tagline: Scope, plan and land a project without losing the thread.

commands.name: /project-scope
commands.summary: Write the scope statement: done test, out-of-scope list, constraints, assumptions.

commands.name: /project-plan
commands.summary: Build the milestone plan with owners, dates, dependencies and the named critical path.

commands.name: /project-status
commands.summary: Report position against plan, slip in days, blockers and the next decision due.

commands.name: /project-risk
commands.summary: Maintain the risk register: risk, trigger, response, owner, review date.

commands.name: /project-change
commands.summary: Open a priced change record with its effect on the landing date.

commands.name: /project-recover
commands.summary: Present the recovery option set: cut scope, extend, add capacity, or stop.

commands.name: /project-land
commands.summary: Run acceptance and closeout, with actual versus planned.

commands.name: /project-abort
commands.summary: Stop the project deliberately, naming what is salvaged and what is written off.

requires_human_approval_for: committing to a date communicated to a client or a stakeholder
accepting a scope change that moves the landing date or the budget
escalating a change to Review & Governance {OS}
